title: Spacious Suite w/Half-Bath Near Nissan
description:
This is a private bedroom in a shared home designed with traveling professionals in mind. Conveniently located between Nashville and Murfreesboro with quick access to I-24 and I-840, the room includes a dedicated workspace, Smart TV, mini fridge, microwave, walk-in closet, and attached half bath. Enjoy free on-site parking and access to the on-site gym. Need more privacy to work? Ask about additional private office space available on site.

The space
Single level house with spacious fenced backyard.

Guest access
Guests have access to the private bedroom, attached half bath, shared full bathroom/shower, shared kitchen, dining room, living room, free on-site laundry, Wi-Fi, free parking, and on-site gym.

During your stay
We respect guests’ privacy while remaining available if needed. Self check-in allows flexible arrival, and we are happy to assist through the Airbnb app during your stay.

Other things to note
This is a private room in a shared home. Quiet hours help maintain a peaceful environment for all guests. Exterior security cameras are located outside the property for safety and security. Weekly and monthly discounts may be available for longer stays.
